description: This file defines types, constants, and functions for managing and resolving Matrix room information, including caching mechanisms for room names, aliases, and member display names.

methods.name: createMatrixRoomInfoResolver
methods.description: Creates and returns an object with methods to retrieve room info and member display names, utilizing internal caching.

methods.name: getRoomName
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the room name and whether it has been resolved, using cache if available.

methods.name: getRoomAliases
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves room aliases and their resolution status, using cache if available.

methods.name: getRoomInfo
methods.description: Retrieves combined room info, including name and optionally aliases, for a given room ID.

methods.name: getMemberDisplayName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name of a member in a room, using cache if available.
